result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, user-first framing, with a first-person plural voice and absolute phrasing ('we know to be true'). The page addresses users first and defines its mission in broad terms of access and usefulness. Employees, investors and governance appear only as navigation teasers, not as stated commitments. Environment and safety are absent. The bottom-line disavowal is worded as a contrast, not a commitment.
